title: THE HUD SPEAKS IN THE MENU TYPEFACE
why: His orders of 2026-10-12: #35 redo the HUD entirely as part of the graphical improvement, and #50 make it look like a triple-A game. Third step of the UI redesign (ui4). Every line of raid text (callouts, prompts, labels, the clock, the ammo, the belt numbers) now uses the same condensed industrial face as the menus, instead of the rounded Rubik. It is narrower, so the same plates hold more words, and it reads like the shooter HUDs he named. Two new text sizes are ready for the HUD rebuild: a big ammo figure and a plain sentence line. The last few places that still named Rubik or Impact (the map zone labels, the empty belt cell, the arcade pages, the shirt number) move too. The face itself is embedded later (ui1, after his OK); until then the built-in Windows condensed face stands in.
now: HUD and raid text now use the same condensed caps face as the menus.
